# !KEEP LIST!
# nullenvironmentsounds — .env files whose audio this toggle leaves untouched (music,
# ambient and footstep sounds kept).
# Source of truth — edit freely (add or remove). Delete the file to restore the default.
# One rule per line. Bare = "contains" match, * = wildcard, # = comment.
#
# Examples (uncomment and adapt):
#   metadata/environmentsettings/maps/                 # keep a whole folder's audio
#   *boss*                                             # keep boss-arena audio
#   metadata/environmentsettings/maps/uberdoryani.env  # keep one file's audio
